setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (3 reviews): The stretch from Deal through Samson And Delilah redeems the show for this reviewer; Named among the real highlights, rather than the big Scarlet>Fire pairing [6][8][9]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Highlight of the show; Keith takes a notable solo [8]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer is unsure about the vocals here, wondering whether Donna sings lead [13]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain pairing is described as tasty [7]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Samson And Delilah is played well [8]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 other source): U.S. Blues closed the show as the encore [1]

## The recordings

- **gd78-11-16.nak300.wiley.11487.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is rough in places, but the energy compensates for the fidelity shortcomings [7]
- **gd78-11-16.psbd.wiley.11486.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 66 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is good quality, though the reviewer finds it chopped up and incomplete; Drums and piano sit too far forward in the soundboard mix, and the early songs sound poorly integrated [6][9]
- **gd1978-11-16.136718.sbd.partial.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 68 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: This soundboard sounds better than the other board, which has the same missing tracks [13]
- **gd1978-11-16.150409.sbd.s2p.flac1644**: soundboard; 4 songs; 25 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first show; the crowd was rowdy Chicago fans and the band energetic [7]
- Garcia sounds loose early on, playing quick muted noodling while a cymbal is fixed [9]
- A dropout at the start of disc 1 track 3 was removed [3]
- Another audience source has the full show, though a different audience tape may be the better-sounding one [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-11-16.nak300.wiley.11487.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak CM-300's [1]
- **gd78-11-16.psbd.wiley.11486.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard converted, edited and seeded to etree by T. Wiley on 8/12/02 [3]
- **gd1978-11-16.136718.sbd.partial.flac1644**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Source: SBD > ? > Cassette, from the Brian Schley tape collection. [4]
- **gd1978-11-16.150409.sbd.s2p.flac1644**: transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 07/2020; source: SBD (mono) unknown lineage > Cassette rescued from ebay. [5]. Also: This soundboard copy was rescued from eBay; its origin and why it went missing remain unknown [15]
